main.description: The workflows under .knotless/workflows at a ref of a repository, in file name order, each with what runs it there, as `knotless workflow list` lists them: which its owner may ask for by name, with variables, through dev.knotless.requestRerun. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

errors.description: No such repository, or no such ref.
errors.name: NotFound

ref.description: A branch or a tag, by name or in full; the default branch if none.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

scheduleView.description: One schedule a workflow runs on, at the default branch's tip.

cron.description: A cron expression, in UTC: minute hour day month weekday, or @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly or @yearly.

workflowView.description: A workflow at the ref, and what runs it there.

asked.description: Its owner may ask for it at the ref by name: it runs on a push there, its asked trigger names the ref, or the ref is the default branch and it has a schedule.

error.description: Why it does not load: nothing runs it then.

name.description: What its checks are filed as.

pull.description: A pull into the ref, a branch, runs it.

push.description: A push to the ref runs it.

schedule.description: The schedules it runs on at the ref, the default branch; none at any other ref.

description: A repository's workflows at a ref, and what runs each there.
